answer: No, you don't need a payoff letter. Bayline Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so we confirm your payoff directly with them the same day, at your appointment, using your loan account number. Just bring the other items on the appointment checklist, such as photo ID for every owner on the title, your current registration, all keys and remotes, and the odometer disclosure statement (form NW-ODO-2). Keep making your regular loan payments until Bayline confirms the loan is paid off.
